name: Skeleton of Thought
description: Skeleton of Thought is a two-phase generation strategy that separates structural planning from detailed writing. In the first phase, the model produces a concise numbered skeleton of up to max_points distinct logically ordered points without filling in details, serving as a scaffold that guarantees coverage of all required topics before any prose is written. In the second phase, the model expands each skeleton point independently into polished self-contained prose, focusing only on the assigned point. This decomposition makes the strategy ideal for long-form content generation — reports, articles, documentation, and educational material — where structural coherence across sections is critical. Because each point is expanded in isolation, the approach also enables parallel execution across multiple model calls. The final output is assembled from the individually expanded points to produce a complete document with clear logical flow.

prompts.skeleton_prompt: Create a concise numbered skeleton for answering the task. Use no more than {max_points} points. Make each point distinct and ordered logically. Do not fill in the details yet. Keep every point short enough to guide a later expansion. Return only the numbered skeleton.
prompts.expand_prompt: Complete this one skeleton point for the original task. Stay focused on the provided point. Add the facts, reasoning, and examples needed for that point to stand alone. Do not rewrite unrelated skeleton points. Keep the expansion coherent with the full task. Return polished prose for this point only.
